text:
riley: heads up — pushing v2.8.1 to prod slice-alpha in ~15m (22:00 PT). rolling over 10 nodes. @maria smoke lead, @ajay rollback lead. keep this thread for quick checks.

maria: acked. I'll run the probe suite and watch traces. plan: run `curl` probe, check p50/p95, and a light eval on generation quality.

ajay: noted. rollback procedure is ready (k8s rollout undo + pin to v2.8.0). I have the helm patch prepared.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by riley at 3176543350. diff: model-serving: bump v2.8.0 -> v2.8.1; runtime: enable kv-cache-opt.

leo: quick config check — are we using the new batching profile? I saw `batch-config: auto-v2` in the canary.

riley: yes, batch-config auto-v2 enabled on slice-alpha only. will keep slice-beta on old profile for fallback.

maria: smoke start: running curl probe against /v1/generate (5 requests)

maria: probe results: 200, 200, 200, 200, 200; latencies (ms): 42, 47, 45, 200, 46. one 200ms spike but payload was larger.

tamsin: seeing a small uptick in token compute on dashboard for slice-alpha +8% — likely batching behavior. not alarming.

leo: rolling logs show intermittent `KV cache miss` lines. expected during first warmups. will monitor.

maria: running quick eval set (5 prompts) for quality regression

maria: eval: outputs look fine. no hallucination spikes. Bleu/similarity unchanged.

ajay: rollback test — simulated undo on staging works; helm rollback restores previous replica counts within 40s.

ops-runner: infra checks: pod restarts 0, OOM 0, CPU < 60% across nodes. autoscaler not triggered.

riley: thanks. keep watching for 10m more. if any error-rate > 0.5% or p95 > 300ms call rollback.

maria: setting a watch: will ping here on alerts. :eyes:

leo: one more note — client-side retry window set to 2s, so we shouldn't see timeouts for these p95s.

tamsin: added a short dashboard panel for cache-warmup ratio and batching depth.

deploy-bot: canary success on slice-alpha at 3176543420. promoting to full slice per policy.

maria: promote acknowledged. starting full sweep on promoted nodes.

maria: full sweep quick results: 50/50 probes 200; p50 40ms p95 62ms. error rate 0.02% in last 5m.

ajay: still standing by. rollback ready if threshold hit.

riley: looks good. closing bakewindow at 22:30 PT unless anyone flags. leave notes for support: baked v2.8.1, enabled kv-cache-opt, batching auto-v2 on alpha->full.

tamsin: note added to runbook and confluence with metrics links. :white_check_mark:

leo: thanks team. small follow-up: will watch embeddings throughput tomorrow morning (higher qps there).

maria: thanks all — closing thread in 10m unless new alerts.

riley: thanks — great work :tada:
